thread:
Priya Shah: Heads up — Atlas (hardware KMS + SSO partner) wants to push a joint listing to the Cloud Marketplace next week. Need sync on SSO/SCIM and KMS packaging.
Kevin Li: sweet. do we have the Marketplace listing checklist? (links?)
Ana Gómez: I uploaded the draft partner deck here: https://redwood.share/partner-decks/atlas-md — section on security integrations is incomplete.
Carlos Mendes: quick questions: 1) Are we shipping SAML-only SSO or also OIDC? 2) SCIM user provisioning required? 3) KMS integration: envelope or direct HSM?
Priya Shah: Partner is SAML-first but can do OIDC. They require SCIM for automated user provisioning. For KMS they prefer an HSM-backed envelope key flow with attestation.
Kevin Li: ok. From infra side we need: metadata URL, ACS URL, and attribute map for SCIM -> our user model. Can we get sample SAML metadata from their IdP?
Atlas Partner Bot: Atlas Prod SAML metadata uploaded: https://atlas.partners/saml/metadata.xml (expires 7 days)
Ana Gómez: tagging comms/legal — @Kevin Li can you paste the minimal SAML metadata snippet we need to publish on the Marketplace listing? Also need the SCIM attribute map example for the listing copy.
Kevin Li: minimal SAML snippet for Marketplace:
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://id.atlas.example">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://api.redwood.example/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
SCIM attribute mapping (example):
```
externalId -> profile.external_id
userName -> email
name.givenName -> profile.first_name
name.familyName -> profile.last_name
active -> status.is_active
groups -> memberships.group_ids
```
Priya Shah: perfect. Also we need to call out KMS/HSM flow in the listing: we support customer-provided HSM via Atlas (PKCS#11) with monthly key rotation hooks and remote attestation. Any blockers?
Carlos Mendes: two items: 1) HSM integration requires our Private deployment docs to show PKCS#11 modules + example config. 2) Rotation hooks — partner needs an endpoint to call when rotation completes. What's the URL?
Kevin Li: rotation webhook endpoint will be https://api.redwood.example/kms/partner-rotation Atlas must sign payloads with their webhook token. We'll share a test token.
Ana Gómez: timeline question — partner marketing wants a co-announcement 5/12. Is engineering confident we can ship Marketplace entry + SCIM + KMS docs by then?
Priya Shah: realistic: Marketplace listing and SAML/SCIM examples + basic docs by 5/12. HSM attestation and rotation webhooks might land a week later unless partner can accept a staged rollout (Marketplace copy says HSM integration "coming soon" with private beta).
Carlos Mendes: staging approach sounds fine. We'll need a canary policy for the private beta and a contact alias for on-call.
Kevin Li: I'll create a short runbook (deploy steps + test checklist) and a canary policy. Will post link here by EOD.
Priya Shah: comms ask: add legal blurb about data residency and customer-managed keys. Ana, can you draft marketplace copy referencing the private beta and include the SAML/SCIM/KMS bullets?
Ana Gómez: on it. I'll send draft to @Priya and @Kevin for review.
Atlas Partner Bot: Partner requests joint logo lock by 5/10 and copy signoff by 5/11.
Priya Shah: noted. Kevin — can you confirm we can provide a short demo script for the marketplace listing (SSO login + provisioning + rotate key)?
Kevin Li: yes — demo script + postman collection. I'll attach before EOD.
Carlos Mendes: one more: security review — require a threat model checklist item for KMS HSM attestation. We should loop in security team (sec-review alias).
Priya Shah: looping them now. @Carlos please add checklist items and ping sec-review.
Ana Gómez: summary actions: 1) Kevin -> runbook + demo + webhook details 2) Carlos -> PKCS#11 config snippet + canary policy + threat checklist 3) Priya -> partner coord + key dates 4) Ana -> marketplace copy + partner deck update.
Kevin Li: got it. Will update thread with links. :thumbsup:
Priya Shah: thanks everyone — let's aim for a short sync tomorrow 10am PT to unblock final copy.
Ana Gómez: 10am works.
Atlas Partner Bot: Calendar invite created: Atlas x Redwood Integration — 2026-05-05 10:00 PT.
Priya Shah: nice — meeting will confirm launch commitments.
